panels.description: Trading status (1=enabled, 0=disabled). In live mode, enabled is expected. In dev/test/paper modes, enabled indicates an incident.
panels.title: 1. Trading Enabled

panels.description: Sum of unsafe state indicators. 0 = safe, >0 = unsafe (trading must be disabled immediately)
panels.title: 2. Unsafe State (Kill Switch)

panels.description: Execution service health status. 1 = UP, 0 = DOWN (CRITICAL)
panels.title: 3. Execution Service Up

panels.description: Active trading halt reason. NONE = trading allowed. Any other value = STOP TRADING
panels.title: 4. Trading Halt Reason

panels.description: Active enforcer tier configuration
panels.title: 5. Enforcer Tier

panels.description: Time since last market data tick. Flat rising line = feed stalled. Spikes = provider instability.
panels.title: 6. Market Data Lag

panels.description: Data provider connection status. 1 = connected, 0 = disconnected
panels.title: 7. Data Provider Connected

panels.description: Data gaps detected in the last 5 minutes. Any gap in live mode = immediate trading stop.
panels.title: 8. Data Gaps (Last 5m)

panels.description: Rate of A+ signals generated per minute
panels.title: 9. Signals Generated Rate

panels.description: Signal rejection reasons in the last 5 minutes
panels.title: 10. Signal Rejection Reasons

panels.description: Average signal score. Must be >= 8.0 for A+ quality. Below threshold = DO NOT TRADE
panels.title: 11. A+ Quality Gate

panels.description: 95th percentile signal generation latency
panels.title: 12. Signal Generation Latency (p95)

panels.description: Orders sent vs successfully filled
panels.title: 13. Orders Sent vs Filled

panels.description: Order rejection reasons in the last 5 minutes. Any non-zero in live mode = investigate immediately.
panels.title: 14. Order Rejections

panels.description: 95th percentile order acknowledgment and fill latency
panels.title: 15. Execution Latency (p95)

panels.description: Current number of active trades
panels.title: 16. Open Positions

panels.description: Today's cumulative P&L in points
panels.title: 17. Daily PnL

panels.description: Today's maximum drawdown. Thresholds: <300 = green, 300-480 = orange, >480 = red (PDLL at 600)
panels.title: 18. Daily Drawdown

panels.description: Current HTF bias: 1=Bullish, 0=Neutral, -1=Bearish
panels.title: 19. HTF Bias Current

panels.description: HTF bias changes in the last hour. High frequency (>4) = choppy market, Low (<2) = trending
panels.title: 20. HTF Bias Change Frequency

panels.description: Current consecutive loss count. 0=green, 1=orange, >=2=red
panels.title: 21. Loss Streak Current

panels.description: Redis connection status. 1=connected, 0=disconnected
panels.title: 22. Redis Connectivity

panels.description: 95th percentile event processing latency by service
panels.title: 23. Event Processing Latency (p95)

panels.description: 95th percentile database query latency by service and operation. Alert if >1s
panels.title: 24. Database Query Latency (p95)

panels.description: Feature queue depth. 0-10=normal, 10-50=backlog building, >50=bottleneck
panels.title: 25. Feature Queue Depth
